name: sugarcraft/sugar-quickpick
description: Fuzzy finder / quick-pick overlay for terminal UIs. Wraps a background view, renders a filterable, rankable list overlay on top with borders and styles, background continues to update underneath. JSONL-backed selection history. Inspired by Genekkion/theHermit (Go); developed as a native PHP project.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Required for QuickPick::attachSigwinch() to re-render the overlay on SIGWINCH terminal resizes.
suggest.sugarcraft/sugar-pty: Installs the SIGWINCH handler automatically in QuickPick::attachSigwinch() (its SignalForwarder; brings an ext-ffi install floor with it). Without it attachSigwinch() returns false and the host drives resizes itself via QuickPick::invalidateAutoWidth() or its own installer callable.
